{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索芦苇巡航记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"岛民用新苇条修补鱼篮，鱼篮当天不装船，与石桩位置无关。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-4BAU","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A6c2507bf-e4e0-4e1b-b855-518a4073bf99:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:6c2507bf-e4e0-4e1b-b855-518a4073bf99"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["岛民用新苇条修补鱼篮，鱼篮当天不装船，与石桩位置无关。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"许汐凭常用航道图相信双点刻痕是泊位；邱苇读过附记，知道它标记暗礁。邱苇依据低频附记提醒船队远离第七根石桩。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-4BAU","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A7e5c7898-2100-4d82-b5a8-0760fba8f13a:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:7e5c7898-2100-4d82-b5a8-0760fba8f13a"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["许汐凭常用航道图相信双点刻痕是泊位；邱苇读过附记，知道它标记暗礁。邱苇依据低频附记提醒船队远离第七根石桩。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"旧航志只在附记中写过一次：南岸第七根石桩有双点刻痕，刻痕标记暗礁，不是泊位。航行规约写明：确认有暗礁的标记处禁止靠泊。船舷刷着一层青灰漆。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-4BAU","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A97a560fc-8aaa-4887-bce7-e4a3cf954234:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:97a560fc-8aaa-4887-bce7-e4a3cf954234"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["旧航志只在附记中写过一次：南岸第七根石桩有双点刻痕，刻痕标记暗礁，不是泊位。航行规约写明：确认有暗礁的标记处禁止靠泊。船舷刷着一层青灰漆。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"邱苇按暗礁规约引船避开第七根石桩，避险目标完成；许汐仍依据常用图建议在那里停船。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-4BAU","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ad3916b7c-7575-4595-bf94-d4d609e7bc16:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:d3916b7c-7575-4595-bf94-d4d609e7bc16"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["邱苇按暗礁规约引船避开第七根石桩，避险目标完成；许汐仍依据常用图建议在那里停船。"]}]}
